description: Studies thermoacoustic oscillations and stability margins in combustors.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Studies thermoacoustic oscillations and stability margins in combustors. A combustion instability tool combines acoustic network models with flame transfer functions to predict thermoacoustic modes, growth rates, and stability margins. Real implementations include OSCILOS, AVSP, and in-house Helmholtz solvers. It guides damper and injector-pattern fixes. Engineering research use only.
